purpose: reader-facing explanation of the AI Engineering Buildcamp's project sequence, framework strategy, and core/optional structure

required_facts.fact: AI Engineering Buildcamp was defined as a project-driven course focused on building AI systems with an engineering mindset.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 15-17 and 27: name, rationale, and project-driven description are stated.

required_facts.fact: The Capstone starts in Week 1, is refined conceptually and through implementation, and is built and polished during the final two weeks.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 29: the Capstone sequence is described.

required_facts.fact: More than six guided mini-projects cover FAQ assistants, YouTube Q&A systems, documentation agents, coding agents, and deep research agents.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 31: mini-project count and examples are given.

required_facts.fact: The structure was changed after participants said the content was dense and the pace too fast.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 35-39: feedback and redesign reason are stated.

required_facts.fact: The redesigned version was longer, less dense, and organized around a main path plus optional bonus material.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 41-46: core and optional structure are specified.

required_facts.fact: The course first implements agents without a framework, including manual tool calling and control loops.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 57: framework-free foundation is described.

required_facts.fact: The manual foundation is intended to support understanding framework internals, source code, debugging, and cases where an existing framework does not fit.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 59-64: the four reasons for the approach are listed.

required_facts.fact: PydanticAI is introduced as the primary framework after the foundation, with attention to typing, validation, testing, and production concerns.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 66: primary framework and deeper concerns are stated.

required_facts.fact: LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google Agent Development Kit, and CrewAI are optional frameworks.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 68-73: optional framework list is given.

required_facts.fact: OpenAI is the main model provider, while Groq, Anthropic, Gemini, and Z.ai are also covered.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 75: provider coverage is specified.

author_attribution: Explain the course design as documented by Alexey and preserve the distinction between the primary path and optional coverage.
